source_provider: Purdue University ArcGIS BuildingShapesZip4 FeatureServer layer 0

source_to_model_transform.limitation: Local geographic approximation, not survey-grade CRS.

shell_selection: Read-only fresh Blender reopen. Source shell candidate names from master_building_audit.json; plus only named connector/core structural shell components. Decorative, glazing, furniture, and paths excluded.
limitations: GIS outline has no documented wall-face survey semantics; 2023 orthophoto supports it as roof/edge proxy.
Model shell union uses convex hulls per named structural shell; local setbacks and openings may bridge.
The Hausdorff maximum is an isolated extreme and should be read with mean/P95 and visual overlay.
